THE ARK: The WORKER OF SECRETS dared to place an Impostor on your throne! Confront the WORKER at his seat of power, and teach him the price of usurping THE GOD KING.
THE STRONGHOLD AT LARIOTH: RAIDRIAR has made the ultimate sacrifice - it must not be in vain. Retrieve the WORKER's datapod from RAIDRIAR's stronghold in Larioth to find what information it contains.

items.displayName: ACT II - BURIED IN THE PAST
items.description: THE SECCIAN DESERT: The WORKER is arming the Deathless with Infinity Weapons. Investigate his secret excavation in the Seccian Desert to learn the origin of these tools of destruction.
THE PIT: Track down THERIN, the Deathless lord who runs brutal bloodsports in his arena, The Pit. He may have been armed with an Infinity Weapon...
THE BROKEN TOWER: Locate and rescue JENSEN, the captured Blacksmith of SIRIS' home, Drem's Maw. Recruit him and his skills for SIRIS' secret offensive.
THE VAULT OF TEARS: Return to AUSAR's former stronghold, the Vault of Tears, to discover how the WORKER stole his memory. TEL will show you where to look...
THE PINNACLE MONASTERY: Investigate why LELINDRE, one of the oldest and most powerful Deathless, has aligned herself with the WORKER. Find out if she was given one of the Infinity Weapons...
THE ARK: All roads have led to this. Journey to the WORKER's seat of power in the Hidden Lands, and stop him from unleashing his wrath and burning the world to ashes.
REWARD:
THE PINNACLE MONASTERY: LELINDRE has many treasures hidden here in her seat of power - but she won't have left them unguarded.
THE SECCIAN DESERT: The WORKER's most ancient and powerful treasures were excavated here. Some of them remain locked away, guarded and protected by the fiercest of Daeril.
THE HILLS OF LARIOTH: The DRAGON is wounded and has been spotted in Larioth. Destroy her before she can recover and wreak further devastation upon the land.
NAFUSAAN MOUNTAINS: The ancient DRAGON is wounded and has been spotted near her nest. Destroy her before she can recover and wreak further devastation upon the land.
THE HILLS OF LARIOTH: The DRAGON is wounded and has been spotted in Larioth. Destroy her before she can recover and wreak further devastation upon the land.
NAFUSAAN MOUNTAINS: This frozen wasteland is filled with danger... and treasure!
NAFUSAAN MOUNTAINS: Only the bravest, and most foolish, of warriors has ever dared attempt to claim the treasures sitting at the feet of the legendary and fearsome Dragoor - King of Dragons!
DREM'S MAW: With RAIDRIAR dead, fierce Daeril and Wildlings now roam the land terrorizing smaller villages. Getting rid of them helps the people... and fills your pockets.
DREM'S MAW: Chaos has erupted as the Soulless AUSAR runs rampant through RAIDRIAR'S former Kingdom! Go to Drem's Maw and ensure that SIRIS's boyhood home is safe.

THE METIUS OBSERVATORY: The ancient Observatory is locked and sealed by ancient magics that will open only to those equipped with the right keys, but the surrounding hills are littered with treasure...
THE METIUS OBSERVATORY: TERROVAX hinted that the WORKER sent OSLIM, one of his most cunning Deathless Bloodmages, to investigate this ancient site. He travels armed with an Infinity Weapon...
THE DARK CITADEL: You are the Sacrifice, and like your father before you it is your destiny to try and slay THE GOD KING!
THE VAULT OF TEARS: Seek out the WORKER OF SECRETS - the legendary creator of the Infinity Blade - and convince him to join you! Rumor says that he is imprisoned in the VAULT OF TEARS...
THE PLAINS OF KOROTH: Danger still lurks near the legendary battleground where AUSAR was hunted down and slain by RAIDRIAR.
THE PLAINS OF KOROTH: Rumor tells of a secret cult dedicated to resurrecting AUSAR THE VILE. Though risky, there may be a way to learn what the WORKER is really plotting...
THE STRONGHOLD AT LARIOTH: RAIDRIAR once kept many valuables here. Beware - his guards will defend them, even if he can use them no longer.
THE DARK CITADEL: Though the GOD KING no longer rules here, treasure and glory still await those brave enough to tread the former path of The Sacrifice.
THE DARK CITADEL: The Soulless AUSAR has left a trail of blood and horror along his path to wreak vengeance upon RAIDRIAR. Destroy him before more innocents die.
THE HILLS OF LARIOTH: The DRAGON is wounded and has been spotted in Larioth. Destroy her before she can recover and wreak further devastation upon the land.
THE METIUS OBSERVATORY: TERROVAX hinted that the WORKER sent OSLIM, one of his most cunning Deathless Bloodmages, to investigate this ancient site. He travels armed with an Infinity Weapon...
THE BROKEN TOWER: Only the vilest of beings are sent here - but not everything left here to rot is without value...
THE CREVASSE: The COLLECTOR has left his secret trove to explore the world, looking for weapons of true craftmanship. Though guarded, he left much treasure here...
THE CREVASSE: Mystery shrouded in legend hints that a trove of mythical weapons may be hidden here, at the center of the Scarred Wastes...
